title: Severe waterlogging on NH44 near Hyderabad causes multi-kilometer freight gridlock
description: Continuous overnight downpour flooded low-lying sections of National Highway 44 between Shamshabad and Shadnagar. Heavy transport vehicles diverted to state highways.

title: Landslide clearance underway on Mumbai-Pune Expressway ghat section
description: Loose boulders fell across the expressway corridor near Khandala, closing two lanes towards Pune. Highway police operating alternate one-way transit.

title: Dense fog warning across Delhi-Jaipur NH48 corridor reduces visibility below 50m
description: IMD issues orange alert for morning logistics operations across Haryana and Rajasthan border stretches of NH48. Commercial freight speed restricted to 40 km/h.

title: Protest march blocks toll plaza on Yamuna Expressway near Mathura
description: Local farmer union demonstration halts freight traffic at Milestone 82. Express logistics convoys redirected via Old GT Road.

title: Road widening construction prompts 3-hour scheduled slowdowns near Chennai Port
description: Civil works on Ennore port connectivity road creates localized staging queues for container trailers.
